usedFor: Sampark setu checks contacts with “Verify WhatsApp Numbers” and sends through your account with “Send Personalized WhatsApp Messages”.

bestTemplate.name: “Verify WhatsApp Numbers” in Sampark setu
bestTemplate.why: It checks which numbers are registered, so you only message contacts who can receive it.

watchOut: “Send Personalized WhatsApp Messages” reaches people outside, so each send waits in Needs you for approval.
